program.label: NEH Syriac Parchment Descriptions Grant, Sinai Palimpsests Project
program.description: Catalogued as part of UCLA Library's "Identification and Description of the Syriac and Arabic Manuscripts at St. Catherine’s Monastery of the Sinai, Phase 1: Syriac Parchment Manuscripts" project (2022-2025), funded by the National Endowment for the Humanities. Principle cataloguers were Grigory Kessel (Lead cataloguer), Natalia Smelova (Associate cataloguer), and Vevian Zaki (Cataloguer for Arabic content in Syriac manuscripts). , Imaged and studied as part of the Sinai Palimpsests Project (2011–2016), a collaboration between St. Catherine’s Monastery of the Sinai, the Early Manuscripts Electronic Library, and UCLA Library, funded by the Arcadia Fund and the Ahmanson Foundation. The project used multispectral imaging and scholarly analysis to recover and document erased and obscured texts in palimpsest manuscripts from the monastery’s collection.

note.value: Pencil foliation in bottom margin of recto
Regular quire consisting of eight single-folios, sewn between ff. 4 and 5; stubs of conjoins barely detectable; no two folios are conjoins

The fragment (with consecutive folios) may be a complete quire; hence the quires of 8 ff. No visible quire signatures suggests that an outer bifolium is missing, in this case the quires of 10 ff. Final or penultimate quires of a codex.
Unbound quire; most of outer margin missing; large area at lower half missing throughout
